checks: The graphical terminal launched the stock database demo and opened its write form.
The form saved account 0 with name 'ARM64 account' and address 'QEMU disk round trip'.
The database file was read back and the stock application reopened the saved account with both fields visible.
The app exited to a working terminal where 40+2; returned 42.
adaptation: The ARM64 source bundle replaces the stock ClassRep(&a) display call with direct formatting of the same two fields because the current ARM64 reflection layout does not match the x86 ZealOS ClassRep ABI.
scope_note: QEMU runtime acceptance for same-boot file write/read and terminal recovery. This does not establish power-cycle persistence, live UTM behavior, or Raspberry Pi behavior.
